journey.name: contact import
journey.description:
After adopting a Pubky Ring identity that follows other pubkys on pubky.app, the contact import overview lists those follows. Import All saves every follow with the profile the overview already looked up, without looking each one up again, so it finishes in a few seconds. A follow with no published profile is imported too, under its truncated key. While the import runs, Select and Import All are disabled, and leaving the screen does not stop the import.
Precondition (not a listed capability): Pubky Ring installed on the same simulator or device and signed by the same Apple team, with an identity that follows at least five pubkys on pubky.app, at least one of them with no published profile. An onboarded E2E Bitkit build with Paykit UI enabled and no Pubky identity in Bitkit. The journey adopts that identity and saves its follows as contacts, so sign out of it in Bitkit before running the journey again. See README.md.
A warm network can finish the import before the screen is inspected; report "already imported" rather than failing.

actions.action: Tap the header profile button (id "ProfileButton"); if the profile intro (id "ProfileIntro") shows, tap Continue (id "ProfileIntro-button")
Tap the Ring row (id "PubkyChoiceRing_<pubky>") of the identity that follows other pubkys
Wait for the contact import overview (id "ContactImportOverviewProfile", predicate exists) and note the number of friends the summary (id "ContactImportOverviewSummary") shows
Tap Import All (id "ContactImportOverviewImportAll") and note the time

While Import All shows its spinner, verify Select (id "ContactImportOverviewSelect") is disabled: tapping it does not open the selection screen. If Pay Contacts (id "PayContactsContinue") already shows, the import finished first: report "already imported" and continue
Wait for Pay Contacts (id "PayContactsContinue", predicate exists) and report how long the import took from the tap
Tap Continue (id "PayContactsContinue") and wait for Profile to open
Tap the menu button (id "HeaderMenu"), then Contacts (id "DrawerContacts"); if the contacts intro shows, tap its continue button
Verify Contacts lists one row (id "Contact_<pubky>") for each of the friends the overview counted, and that a follow with no published profile shows its truncated key as its name
